name: New York John F. Kennedy International
subtitle: Stand assignment and push control for Terminals 1, 4, 5, 7 and 8, the T4 hardstands, Zulu and RON Parking
source: Stands and headings, taxiways, aprons and buildings from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL): each stand 20 m back from the nose end of its lead-in line. Gate and hardstand list, ramp control frequencies, the T4 communications split and the T4 entry hold points from the Jeppesen 20-9 / 20-9A ramp charts and parking gate coordinate tables (user-supplied). Placed from the charts where OSM has no line: T4 hardstands 85-89, 98, 99 (20-9A, shifted to OSM's line 90), T5 506A, 506B, 601, 601A, H31, H32 (20-9 overview), and T1 gate 9 (OSM gate node, 25 m out). Terminal 7's outline is traced from the 20-9 (OSM no longer maps it). OSM names mapped to the chart: T7 7M is 7W, T8 31 and 32 are the lettered OSM lines nearest those gates, T4 43 is OSM B43A, T4 73 is OSM '73 A380', Zulu H12 is OSM's second H11, de-ice D3 is OSM D13. Not on the chart, so left out: OSM 529A, 529B, 530B, B42A, B44, B46A, T7 10/11, T8 31A-D/32F-I extras. Generated frame: north up, 1.5 m/px, linear in lat/lon.

positions.name: Terminal 1 Ramp
positions.note: Terminal 1 Ramp Control 130.275: gates 1-11 and hardstands HS1-HS2B.

positions.name: Terminal 4 Ramp
positions.note: Intl Terminal 4 Ramp Control 130.775, east of the B concourse: Concourse A, Concourse B odd gates and hardstands 61-79 (entering and exiting on Twys A8 and H).

positions.name: Terminal 4 Ramp
positions.note: Intl Terminal 4 Ramp Control 131.85, west of the B concourse: Concourse B even gates and hardstands 85-99 (entering and exiting on Twys A12 and A13).

positions.name: Terminal 8 Ramp
positions.note: Terminal 8 Ramp Control 129.2: Concourses B and C, gates 10-20 and RON Parking A-E (RON on 129.2 is inferred: it sits inside the T8 ramp).

positions.name: Terminal 5 Ramp
positions.note: The 20-9 charts give no ramp frequency for Terminal 5 or Zulu Parking (both lie east of the T4 communications boundary), so the stand telex has no CTC line.

positions.name: Building 23
positions.note: No ramp frequency on the chart.

airlinesSource: Approximate (late 2026): Delta, its partners and Delta Connection at Terminal 4, JetBlue and partners at Terminal 5, American and oneworld at Terminal 8, United and others at Terminal 7, most foreign carriers at Terminal 1. Hardstands, Zulu, RON and Building 23 are not given out automatically.
notes: Terminal 1 Ramp Control 130.275, Terminal 7 Ramp Control 128.925, Terminal 8 Ramp Control 129.2.

Intl Terminal 4 Ramp Control: 131.85 west of the B concourse (entering and exiting on Twys A12 and A13), 130.775 east of it (Twys A8 and H). Contact after landing for apron entry and parking, and before push for start-up and taxi sequencing. Gate Hold 125.05.

Arrivals for T4 gate A2 proceed via taxilane HB for wingtip clearance. Taxilane G is limited to wingspans under 118 ft when Alternate G is in use. ALT BB (wingspans 214-262 ft) closes hardstands 78-79A.
T4 start-up points (1-25) are on the 20-9A, not drawn here. T4 entry hold points A8, A10, A11, A12, A13 are drawn on the taxilane each one leaves the ramp by.
The charts give no ramp frequency for Terminal 5, Zulu Parking or Building 23. De-ice pads D1-D8 sit in Zulu (20-9F/20-9G).
